title: 1815 Prairie's low iron railing across its north side yard
items: The Sears-Meeker house at 1815 Prairie now has the low iron railing that its square-on photograph shows across the north side yard. The railing is about 0.8 m high, with a band of spear tips along its top, on a low stone curb. It stands about 2 m behind the front wall and runs from the lot line to the stair wing on the house's north side.
